provenance.ids: Stable OpenTree taxonomy identifiers prefixed with ott; sourceId is the original uid.
provenance.selection: Named higher taxa from domain through order across life; named Mammalia, Aves and Rosaceae branches at all ranks; every original intermediate ancestor retained. This is a subset, not the complete taxonomy.
provenance.parentSemantics: Every retained parent is the exact source parent; no skipped ancestors, synthetic nodes or invented links. Targets with excluded ancestors are omitted.
provenance.limitations: No common names, descriptions or synonyms added. Extinct taxa retained. Apparent terminal taxa outside the three selected branches may have omitted descendants. OTT 3.3 is a historical 2021 release, not a current classification.
